scope: tests coexistence/superposition of two historical traces in native K; contextual weighting by present similarity was diagnostic-null and is NOT part of this confirmation

histories.single_trace_references: A-only and B-only histories matched to their exact temporal slots
histories.common_present: same naive fast/current carrier before probe
histories.probe: all eight current perturbations, identical future noise

response: 12-step actions + dx + dr + dtheta, with new credit suppressed

analysis.pair_fit: fit dual response in the span of normalized A-only and B-only K responses
analysis.wrong_pair_control: replace A/B references by single traces from the next unrelated pair
analysis.best_single_control: compare pair-span R2 against the better of A-only or B-only fits
analysis.older_trace_fraction: absolute coefficient of older trace divided by sum of absolute A/B coefficients

primary_hypotheses.H1_high_dual_reconstruction: mean correct K pair-span R2 >0.90 and >85% seeds exceed 0.85
primary_hypotheses.H2_correct_pair_specificity: correct-pair R2 - wrong-pair R2 >0; one-sided sign-flip, >75% favorable seeds, bootstrap lower bound >0, mean advantage >0.25
primary_hypotheses.H3_both_traces_needed: pair R2 - best-single R2 >0; one-sided sign-flip, >75% favorable seeds, bootstrap lower bound >0, mean gain >0.08
primary_hypotheses.H4_older_trace_persists: mean older-trace coefficient fraction >0.30 and >70% seeds exceed 0.15

secondary_only: residual fraction beyond two-trace linear span

interpretation_rule.all_pass: native K can simultaneously preserve two distinct historical traces whose later response is well described by their superposition; the older trace remains functionally present despite recency
interpretation_rule.fail_H3: dual response may be reconstructible without requiring both traces
interpretation_rule.fail_H4: apparent superposition may be dominated by recency

epistemic_note: does not establish contextual selection, adaptive value, or consciousness
